items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: A lot of 'Bix's solos, I learned 'em myself; I listened to 'em.

ctx.x: Like, "I like this," "I don't like this" or what?

No, most of the records they played, we all liked them. I mean, the ones that we fooled with. They made some, you know, we didn't bother with,we didn't pay 'em no attention. But most of the records they made had that new sound. That's what it was, a new sound to 'em. So we always would get to hear something, and say, "Man, I like that. That's pretty, ain't it. Yeah, let's get that, man." So we'd get it, you know; get together, we'd learn it. Sometimes what happened, sometimes I wouldn't know it. A lot of 'Bix's…
What Bix solos did you learn?
